title: Zero-Copy API Views
goal: Expose internal data efficiently without extra heap allocations.
hints: Returning a borrowed slice view avoids copying string data.
Returning a reference to a local variable created inside the function causes a borrowing error.
explanation: Returning `&str` borrows from the input, so the caller keeps the original text and no allocation happens. Returning `String` is a type mismatch against the declared return type. Returning a reference to a local value is error `E0106`, because the local dies at the end of the function.
